instruction: Generate PDF versions of the blog articles currently visible in Chrome and save them to /home/user/Documents/Blog folder.

metadata.explanation: This variation verifies that the PDFs were recently created by checking file modification timestamps. The evaluator counts PDFs modified within the last 10 minutes in /home/user/Documents/Blog, ensuring at least 2 were newly created during task execution.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly targets the specified folder (/home/user/Documents/Blog) and uses appropriate timestamp filtering (10 minutes)
Metric correctly handles the 'expected' parameter for type='rule' by directly accessing expected.get('count', 2')
Uses >= comparison which appropriately allows for more PDFs than the minimum required
Postconfig ensures the target folder exists before evaluation
Verification covers: correct folder location, correct count (2), and recent creation timestamp
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: The evaluator verifies count and timestamp but cannot verify PDF content or whether PDFs actually correspond to the specific blog articles mentioned in the instruction
Cannot distinguish between PDFs generated from Chrome vs other sources - any 2 PDFs created in the folder would pass
For stronger verification, could check PDF filenames contain keywords from blog URLs or article titles
The 10-minute window is reasonable but could potentially include unrelated PDFs if other PDF operations happen in the same folder during task execution
